title: This Frog Survives Seven Years Buried Alive
description: Discover the incredible survival story of the desert frog, which buries itself alive and enters suspended animation to endure years of extreme drought.
instagram_caption: Buried alive for up to seven years? 🐸🏜️ Nature's survival strategies are mind-blowing. See how this desert frog defeats the dry season! #wildlife #naturelovers #amazinganimals #survivor

segments.narration: To survive a desert baking alive, this frog does the unthinkable: it buries itself alive.
As the wetlands bake into cracked clay, its sensitive skin faces lethal heat, forcing it deep underground.
Deep in the earth, the frog secretes a waterproof cocoon, slowing its heartbeat to survive up to seven years.
broll_queries: close up frog cocoon mucus underground

segments.narration: But when rain finally falls, soaking the parched earth, the tomb begins to soften.
broll_queries: close up water drops hitting dry mud

segments.narration: Sensing the moisture, the frog tears free from its cocoon and claws its way back to the surface.
broll_queries: close up frog breaking out of mud

segments.narration: Life conquers the desert once again. Subscribe to Wonders of Nature for more incredible survival stories.
